title: Palladia panel TV stand
text:
Palladia panel TV stand. This is a nice looking (at least from the picture) tv stand but an absolute misery to assemble. The metal posts that were to keep the vertical interior wall snug to the top and bottom of the cabinet kept falling out, I couldn't get the cams to line up with top,side and bottom, the exterior wall (part B) wouldn't fit into the cam lock and when I tapped it with a rubber mallet the cam broke from the 'part b' and shredded the particle board (to the point where I had to request a replacement part - shipped in a week). I still don't have this assembled and I have put together a drop-leaf sewing machine cabinet (also Sauder) and several other pieces of assemble it yourself pieces (storage cabinets x 3 for our garage and two shelving sets for our guest bedroom, a full executive size desk with hutch for our office to name a few).
It would cost me more money to send it back and request a refund that it does to write it off as a bad idea and move on.The directions - one of the worst I've ever seen. I'm very unhappy and it appears that I'll either have to pay someone to struggle with this thing or dispose of it piece by piece.

product_metadata.title: Sauder Palladia Panel TV Stand, For TV's up to 50", Select Cherry finish
features: Accommodates up to a 50" TV weighing 70 lbs. or less for optimal viewing
Two adjustable shelves hold audio/video equipment of many shapes and sizes
Adjustable shelf behind each door for flexible storage options
Enclosed back cut-outs allow a convenient path for cables and cords
description: A classic and versatile design. This charming TV stand from the Palladia collection adds timeless beauty to your living space. It accommodates up at a 50" TV making it perfect for binge watching all your favorite movies and shows. It features two adjustable shelves to hold video/gaming equipment along with an adjustable shelf behind each door for additional storage. Finished in Select Cherry, this handsome TV stand is sure to add a splash of style to your home.
